title_en: Technology and Engineering (7/20): The Engineer at the Water Treatment Plant
note_en: 只有…才… (zhǐyǒu… cái…) states a necessary condition, "only if… can…": 只有每一道工序都合格，自来水才能安全地流进居民家中 "Only when every step passes inspection can tap water flow safely into people's homes." Compare 只要…就…, which gives a sufficient condition ("as long as"). In English "only" can move around the sentence, but in Chinese 只有 opens the condition and 才 must come right before the verb of the result.
